summary: SilverPaws combines RT-DETR dog detection and identity tracking with QuadPose F2, a pinned ONNX model that returns 17 AP-10K-order animal landmarks, plus frame-to-frame OpenCV motion. Derived gait values and thresholds are experimental and have not been validated on a labeled set of pet-dog walking clips. Scores and notes use fixed formulas. An optional language model may reword the note without changing measured values.

entries.whatItIs: RT-DETR, PekingU/rtdetr_r50vd_coco_o365, an object detector. The model card license is Apache-2.0.
entries.whatItDoes: When torch and the weights are installed, the server finds dog boxes in sampled frames. The dog class id is read from the model labels. It also notes when a person box is present. That note is informational.
entries.whatItDoesnt: It does not name a condition, decide which leg is weaker, or choose the wellness score.
entries.resultLine: The dog was located with an object detector (RT-DETR).

entries.whatItIs: QuadPose F2, a published ONNX quadruped-pose model from EstevanSL/snapml-quadruped-pose at commit 52f0329b5c9af513b5a8f2820aaea6bbd945d0c0. The pinned checkpoint SHA-256 is f3807433962d8abcee18f1bd45e5ff9e56bd899768b03a6996c3db4ebd12b884. The publisher labels the code and weights Apache-2.0 and says the model was trained on AP-10K (annotations CC BY 4.0). SilverPaws does not train this model.
entries.whatItDoes: When the verified ONNX checkpoint and RT-DETR detector weights are installed, the server estimates 17 AP-10K-order animal landmarks inside the tracked dog's box. Heatmap peak scores are not calibrated probabilities. Derived gait values use experimental formulas and cutoffs.
entries.whatItDoesnt: It does not diagnose a condition or detect pain. Its performance has not been validated on a labeled set of pet-dog walking videos, and the gait metrics are not clinically validated. Missing or low-confidence points are not treated as measurements.
entries.resultLine: QuadPose F2 estimates AP-10K-order animal landmarks; derived gait values remain experimental.

entries.whatItIs: Standard OpenCV frame-difference analysis. This is not a learned model.
entries.whatItDoes: The server compares consecutive frames and records how much the picture changed. This runs on every clip. When pose is unavailable, it is the only movement measurement. When pose runs, this measurement still supplies movement consistency and activity.
entries.whatItDoesnt: It does not find limbs or keypoints, and it is not an AI model.
entries.resultLine: Motion measured with standard video analysis (no AI model).

entries.whatItIs: Fixed formulas and weights in the wellness module.
entries.whatItDoes: Turns the measured values into factor scores and one overall indicator from 0 to 100. A missing measurement is left out. It is not treated as zero.
entries.whatItDoesnt: No AI model chooses or adjusts these scores.
entries.resultLine: Scores come from fixed formulas, not from an AI model.

entries.whatItIs: Sentence templates in the wellness module.
entries.whatItDoes: Builds the plain-language note from the measured values and the scores.
entries.whatItDoesnt: It does not invent numbers, name a condition, or call a language model.
entries.resultLine: Note written from your measurements by fixed rules.

entries.whatItIs: An optional language-model call on the analysis server.
entries.whatItDoes: When SILVERPAWS_LLM_URL and SILVERPAWS_LLM_MODEL are set, the server asks that provider to rephrase the rule-based note. The reply is shown only if it passes validation.
entries.whatItDoesnt: It is off when those variables are unset. It cannot add a measurement, name a condition, or drop a veterinarian recommendation. A failed or invalid reply is discarded and the rule-based note is shown.
entries.resultLine: Note reworded by an AI language model; the numbers are unchanged.

entries.whatItIs: AI coding assistants used while building the app.
entries.whatItDoes: Parts of this app's code and documentation were written with AI coding assistants and reviewed by the team.
entries.whatItDoesnt: This is not a model that runs on a clip. It does not measure a pet or write the note an owner sees from a walk. The team lead confirms this entry's final wording before release.
entries.resultLine: Parts of this app's code and documentation were written with AI coding assistants and reviewed by the team.
